subject.title: Android: Add message copy and text selection to chat screen

question: Should Android chat message long-press ship as a focused Copy/Select Copy action surface first, or include Share and Reply in the same core feature?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the issue proposes multiple user-visible actions and Reply changes message-composition semantics, so implementation should not proceed until maintainers choose the product scope.

options.title: Copy And Select First
options.body: Add message-level Copy and Select Copy now, preserve link tapping and scroll behavior, and leave Share/Reply for a follow-up if product wants them.

options.title: Full Action Sheet
options.body: Ship Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply together, accepting the extra UI and reply-context semantics review before merge.

options.title: Defer Android Core UX
options.body: Keep the issue open but do not sponsor a fix until a broader Android chat interaction pass is planned.

recommendation.title: Copy And Select First
recommendation.body: Add message-level Copy and Select Copy now, preserve link tapping and scroll behavior, and leave Share/Reply for a follow-up if product wants them.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history across Android chat UI and Markdown paths that would own the user-facing behavior boundary.
